newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures end weak, off lows on Friday.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures end weak, off lows on Friday.

text.p: 1450 GMT - Sept bond future ends lower after quiet session. PIBOR weakens a touch with franc late after steady trading all day. Franc off at 3.3785 per mark compared to 3.3775 at open.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.43 pct vs 5.42. Bund spread -14 bp vs -13
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR 96.49, down 1 bp
